messages:
lia_metrics: Heads-up: overnight Prom spike from embed_vector_length labels. ~140k new series, dashboards timed out. :grimacing:
sam_runtime: That was from our per-dim label experiment with mixed-dim batches?
lia_metrics: Yeah. Each (tenant,route,dim) created a series. Prom exploded.
metrics-bot: ALERT: prometheus-cluster-1 series_count > 120k at 03:02 UTC :rotating_light:
oscar_frontend: Graphs went blank for many tenants. Users will freak if this recurs.
maya_prod: Need a short-term safety plus a long-term telemetry plan that preserves percentiles without high cardinality.
sam_runtime: Short-term fix: ingress sampler to cap new (tenant,route,dim) label emission to 10/min; tag excess as dim=overflow. Quick to ship behind a flag.
lia_metrics: Good. For percentiles, propose runtime emits DDSketch blobs to a metrics-collector; collector computes p50/p90/p99 and writes numeric metrics to Prom. No per-dim labels in Prom.
oscar_frontend: Console can show sketch-derived percentiles. Add an opt-in "per-dim sampler" view for power users (sampled dims only). Also surface "estimated error" for each percentile.
maya_prod: Product ok with that. Also add header for client hints: `X-Embed-Shape: dims=1536;batch=3` — optional, validated server-side.
sam_runtime: I'll PR the sampler + header validation behind a feature flag. Runtime will not trust header for billing.
lia_metrics: I'll draft a short design doc for the collector approach and propose top-K reservoir sampling for the dim-explorer stored in ClickHouse.
oscar_frontend: I'll mock a console toggle and error badge, aim for EOW.
maya_prod: Owners: sam -> runtime; lia -> collector doc; oscar -> UI. Infra ops will weigh in on storage choice. Thanks all :thumbsup:
